description: The series-rating rule of kid-hold-5 / grown-up-hold-4 (docs/adr/0019-kid-hold.md, addendum 2026-11-13). Written by hand from the ADR text, not computed with an independent reference. For an episode of a known series the decisive rating is the series' rating when it is present, otherwise the episode's own rating. A series rating is absent when it is null or empty after trimming U+0020 spaces only (the trim of rating.json normalise); a tab, U+00A0 or U+3000 is not trimmed, so such a rating is present, off the ladder, and fails the kid table. 'passesKidCeiling' cases: the decisive rating must be within the kid ceiling (rating.json normalise and the kid table: TV-Y, TV-G, G rank 0; TV-Y7, TV-Y7-FV rank 1; PG rank 2; the ceiling choices are G, TV-Y7 and PG; unrated, Approved and every rating above PG fail every ceiling). 'animatedFamily' cases: (a row with shape movie is a movie whose own rating is the 'episode' value, with no series) the genres are the union of episodeGenres and seriesGenres, which must include Animation and Family, and the signal's rating test (G, TV-G, TV-Y, TV-Y7, TV-Y7-FV, Approved or unrated spellings, or an absent rating, pass) is applied to the decisive rating. Encoding: a row without 'shape' is an episode of a known series; 'episode' is its own officialRating, 'series' is that series' officialRating (null = the series has no rating), and 'episodeGenres' and 'seriesGenres' are their genres. A row with shape movie has no series. 'seriesMadeForKids' cases: a series on its own (KidHold.isSeriesMadeForKids, which the curation reads for tone); 'series' is its officialRating and 'seriesGenres' its genres, and the animated-family signal's rating test decides, so a series rated only with a tab is not made for kids on it. 'madeForKids' cases: whether the episode is made for kids (kids genres, kid studios, children's ratings or the animated-family signal; no studios in these rows). 'dropsFromGrownUp' cases: the grown-up hold drops the episode when it is made for kids and passes the kid table with no ceiling (PG). 'unchanged' cases: shapes the rule does not touch (a movie or an episode with no series ID is judged on its own rating; an episode whose series is unknown fails closed). The entry's own rating follows the same definition of absent wherever it is read (the fallback of a series with no rating, a movie, an episode with no series): null or spaces only is absent and passes the animated-family signal as unrated (and has no tier, so it fails every kid ceiling); any other whitespace is present, off the ladder, and fails both. A blank series rating counts as no rating here; rules-format rule 4 (open and grown-up channels) still treats a blank rating as blocking its episodes. Every port ships this rule under the name kid-hold-5. kid-hold-5 is kid-hold-4 (ADR-0026, studio fold 2) plus this rule, so a kid-hold-5 port must also pass ADR-0026's kid-hold-4.json (studio fold 2, ADR-0026 parts 1-2, is on main).
